title: Rolling Boulders
description: Cellular automaton removing boulders with too few neighbours.
writeup:
## Approach

A grid of boulders (`@`) and empty spaces (`.`). Boulders with fewer than 4 of their 8 neighbours also being boulders are "unstable" and roll away.

## Part 1

Single pass: count all boulders with fewer than 4 boulder neighbours.

## Part 2

Iteratively remove unstable boulders. After each removal pass, some previously stable boulders may become unstable. Repeat until no more boulders are removed. Count the total removed across all iterations.
